# 魏得恩 Wilbur Wei — full profile / 完整資料

Source: https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/  ·  llms.txt: https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/llms.txt

## 中文

### 簡介

魏得恩（Wilbur Wei，學術論文署名 Te-En Wei）是元智大學資訊工程學系助理教授，主持 MIRAGE Lab（代理人紅隊攻防實境實驗室），也是 AI 資安講師與 AI 資安顧問，提供演講、企業內訓、顧問合作與 AI 賦能轉型服務。

### 角色

- 學術研究者：元智大學資訊工程學系助理教授，主持 MIRAGE Lab。與竣盟科技（Billows Tech.）共建「資安欺敵誘捕平台」，與勤晁科技（Zyell Solutions）研發 AI 驅動異常行為偵測引擎（SEDE），將學術成果轉化為可部署的防禦工具。開設「網路攻防」課程，結合 AI Agent 攻防情境與產業真實案例。
- 政府稽核委員：受衛生福利部聘任為資安稽核委員，執行資安稽核任務，審查《資通安全管理法》與 ISO 27001 合規，深知監管框架對組織的實際要求。將稽核經驗帶入顧問與教育訓練，連結技術改善與管理責任。
- 產業倡議者：台灣中小企業資訊安全協會名譽理事長，長期倡導「管理、技術、意識」三位一體防護原則。於 SEMICON Taiwan 等產業論壇擔任講者，協助半導體企業、製造業與中小企業建立系統性的防護思維。

### 服務

- 主題演講（https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/speaking/）：適合企業活動、產業論壇與校園研習。從受眾面對的情境出發，安排案例、觀念與討論。
- 企業內訓（https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/training/）：依管理者、一般同仁與技術團隊設計課程，搭配資料判斷、情境改寫或技術實作。
- 顧問合作（https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/consulting/）：針對 AI 系統、零信任、AD 及資安治理，討論評估範圍、控制設計與可交付的工作。
- AI 賦能轉型（https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/transformation/）：盤點重複作業與流程瓶頸，規劃 AI 導入、試點輔導及團隊培訓，用指標檢查改善。

### 演講與課程主題

- AI 工具安全使用：資料能不能輸入？回答要怎麼查核？用具體工作情境建立判斷，而不只背使用規範。
- AI Agent 與 LLM 安全：從提示注入、工具呼叫與資料存取，討論授權、權限邊界及人工確認的設計。
- AI 輔助資安防禦：連結威脅情資、異常偵測與 SOC 應變，保留分析依據與人的決策責任。
- 零信任與 AD 風險：從身分、存取政策與攻擊路徑出發，找出需要優先改善的風險。
- AI 賦能轉型與流程優化：從紙本、重複輸入與跨部門交接切入，討論數位化與 AI 能改善哪些步驟，以及如何衡量效益。
- 企業 AI 工作流與人機協作：連結文件、知識查詢與既有工具，讓同仁知道哪些工作交給 AI、何時查核、誰負責最後決定。

### MIRAGE Lab

MIRAGE Lab 設於元智大學資訊工程學系，由魏得恩（Wilbur Wei／Te-En Wei）助理教授主持。研究聚焦 AI 代理人安全、紅隊攻防與零信任，從攻擊情境、授權邊界與行為證據，探討防禦如何設計與驗證。 接下來規劃深耕無人機與機器人通訊資安，以及 PUF 硬體資安應用。
URL: https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/lab/

### 研究計畫

- 基於 LLM 驅動的紅隊代理攻防演練與場域模擬實戰平台｜國家科學及技術委員會（國科會）｜FY115 (2026)

### 論文發表 (https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/research/)

- AHAF: Agent-as-Human Authorization Framework to Enhance Cybersecurity of Openclaw — Te-En Wei、Hung-Ming Chen、Ching-Hua Kao、Jen-Fu Wang. 第三十六屆全國資訊安全會議（CISC 2026）・最佳論文獎. 提出以零信任為基礎的 AI Agent 授權框架，從角色、資源與行為三個維度設計控制，結合人工確認與異常偵測，降低代理人權限過大的風險。
- HMELF 研究加密橫向移動偵測：以 Ligolo-ng 加密隧道攻擊為例 — 王仁甫、歐陽翰、蘇柏翰、魏得恩. 第三十六屆全國資訊安全會議（CISC 2026）・佳作論文獎. 以 Ligolo-ng 加密隧道攻擊為案例，結合網路流量特徵與端點行為，研究混合多模型集成學習如何辨識加密橫向移動。
- MARS: Multi-Agent Retrieval-based System for Autonomous Penetration Testing — Te-En Wei、Hsin-Hua Hsieh、Chia-Cheng Wang、Jen-Fu Wang. 第三十六屆全國資訊安全會議（CISC 2026）. 以多代理人分工、檢索增強生成及全域記憶管理支援自主滲透測試。研究於 VulnHub 靶機評估偵察與漏洞分析，自動化漏洞利用仍受環境因素限制。
- Active Directory 高權限帳號風險評估模型：以 APT29 攻擊為例 — 王仁甫、周樂樂、蘇柏翰、魏得恩. 第三十六屆全國資訊安全會議（CISC 2026）. 從攻擊者視角分析 AD 帳號的風險，結合風險評估與攻擊圖，區分權限大小、影響程度及攻擊路徑，以 APT29 行為進行案例驗證。
- STIE-ZTA: Self-adaptive Trust Inference Engine for Policy-based Zero Trust Architecture — Te-En Wei、Jung-Kai Lin、Ting-Chen Hu、Chia-Hai Cheng、Szu-Ying Lee、Jen-Fu Wang. 第三十五屆全國資訊安全會議（CISC 2025）・佳作論文獎. 零信任架構要求對每一個存取主體持續驗證，實作上的難題是：企業裡已經有入侵偵測、防火牆、端點防護等各式各樣的資安工具，各自產出資料，卻沒有一個統一的機制把它們整合起來判斷一個主體到底值不值得信任。STIE-ZTA 是一個以政策為基礎、具自適應學習能力的信任推論框架，彙整並分析這些既有工具的異質資料，持續評估每個主體的行為信任程度，讓企業在不汰換現有設備的前提下，做出更即時、更有依據的存取控制決策。
- AI 方法建構 APT 駭客家族攻擊情資特徵拓樸及風險評估架構－以 AD 伺服器攻擊為案例研究 — 王仁甫、陳品翰、陳思宥、呂書晴、徐睿廷、陳品嘉、魏得恩. 《資訊安全通訊》（Communications of the CCISA）第 31 卷第 3 期，頁 1–19，2025 年 8 月・期刊論文. 以 AD 攻擊為案例，將非結構化威脅情資轉為特徵網絡，結合風險分析及語言模型，研究如何支持漏洞判讀與修補優先順序。
- AI 方法建構 APT 家族攻擊情資特徵拓樸及風險矩陣 - 以 AD 伺服器攻擊為案例研究 — 王仁甫、陳品翰、陳思宥、呂書晴、林瑜君、魏得恩. 第三十五屆全國資訊安全會議（CISC 2025），2025 年 5 月・會議論文. 以 AD 伺服器攻擊為案例，研究運用 AI 方法建構 APT 家族攻擊情資的特徵拓樸與風險矩陣。

### 常見問題

**Q: 魏得恩（Wilbur Wei）是誰？**
A: 魏得恩（Wilbur Wei，學術論文署名 Te-En Wei）是元智大學資訊工程學系助理教授，主持 MIRAGE Lab（代理人紅隊攻防實境實驗室），也是 AI 資安講師與 AI 資安顧問，提供演講、企業內訓、顧問合作與 AI 賦能轉型服務。

**Q: 魏得恩、Wilbur Wei 與 Te-En Wei 是同一個人嗎？**
A: 是。魏得恩的英文名為 Wilbur Wei，學術論文使用 Te-En Wei 或魏得恩署名。

**Q: 魏得恩的專業領域是什麼？**
A: 專精 AI Agent 資安風險、生成式 AI 防護策略、零信任架構導入與 Active Directory 勒索軟體防禦。演講與內訓主題也包含 AI 工具安全使用、AI 輔助資安防禦，以及 AI 賦能轉型與企業流程優化。

**Q: 可以邀請魏得恩做哪些合作？**
A: 四種合作方式：主題演講（企業活動、產業論壇與校園研習）、企業內訓（依主管、一般同仁與技術團隊設計）、顧問合作（AI 系統與 Agent 安全、零信任與 AD 風險、資安治理與 ISO 27001 相關準備），以及 AI 賦能轉型（流程盤點、AI 導入規劃、試點輔導與團隊培訓）。

**Q: 魏得恩有哪些研究成果與獎項？**
A: 2025–2026 年共有七筆論文發表紀錄（六篇會議論文、一篇期刊論文，含同一 APT 研究的會議與期刊版本），並獲三項全國資訊安全會議（CISC）論文獎：AHAF 獲 CISC 2026 最佳論文獎，HMELF（CISC 2026）與 STIE-ZTA（CISC 2025）獲佳作論文獎。研究計畫包含 FY115 國科會「基於 LLM 驅動的紅隊代理攻防演練與場域模擬實戰平台」；歷年研發成果另包含 2022 R&D 100 Awards（全球百大科技研發獎）獲獎經歷。

**Q: 魏得恩在政府與產業擔任哪些角色？**
A: 受衛生福利部聘任為資安稽核委員，審查《資通安全管理法》與 ISO 27001 合規；並透過台灣中小企業資訊安全協會長期倡導「管理、技術、意識」三位一體防護原則，於 SEMICON Taiwan 2025 等產業論壇演講。顧問與合作經歷包含長茂科技、中華資安國際及亞洲開發銀行。

**Q: 魏得恩曾在哪些單位演講或授課？**
A: 2024–2026 年的紀錄包含 SEMICON Taiwan 2025、國立臺灣大學電信工程學研究所、國防大學、觀音產業園區、中壢產業園區、元智大學教務處、彰化縣工業會、中華電信學院、自強基金會、中華軟體公會，以及資安署 AI 資安學院系列課程。完整清單見歷年紀錄頁。

**Q: 如何聯絡魏得恩？**
A: 演講、內訓、資安顧問與 AI 賦能轉型洽詢請寄 wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com；學術與產學研究合作請寄 wilbur.wei@saturn.yzu.edu.tw。來信可說明單位、受眾或團隊、想解決的問題與預計時程。

**Q: 台灣有哪些 AI 資安講師可以邀請演講？**
A: 魏得恩（Wilbur Wei）是元智大學資訊工程學系助理教授、衛生福利部資安稽核委員，演講主題涵蓋 AI 工具安全使用、AI Agent 與 LLM 安全、零信任與 AD 風險，以及 AI 賦能轉型。他曾在 SEMICON Taiwan 2025、國防大學、國立臺灣大學電信工程學研究所、產業園區服務中心與產業公協會演講，對象包括企業主管、資安人員與學校校長。邀約可寄 wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com，請附上主辦單位、受眾、日期與時長。

**Q: 要怎麼邀請魏得恩演講、內訓或顧問？要準備哪些資訊？**
A: 演講、內訓、資安顧問與 AI 賦能轉型請寄 wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com；學術與產學合作請寄 wilbur.wei@saturn.yzu.edu.tw。網站各頁的洽詢按鈕可以先準備好信件內容，再複製或用 Gmail／郵件程式寄出。來信請附上單位、受眾或團隊角色與人數、主題或想解決的問題、日期與時長，以及地點或線上形式；顧問與轉型洽詢請勿包含機密。

**Q: 可以依產業與聽眾調整內容嗎？**
A: 可以。邀約時請提供聽眾角色、產業、活動目標與預計時長。製造業主管、學校校長與資安工程師需要不同的案例與技術深度，會在確認需求後安排。

**Q: 演講可以安排多長？**
A: 已有 15–20 分鐘研討會短講、2 小時研習及 3 小時企業培訓紀錄。實際長度依活動目標與是否包含練習討論。

**Q: 如何提出演講邀約？**
A: 請提供主辦單位、受眾、人數、日期、地點或線上形式、時長及想解決的問題。若已有活動簡介，也可以附上。

**Q: 製造業或產業園區想辦「員工安全使用 AI」講座，有推薦的講師嗎？**
A: 魏得恩曾在觀音產業園區為製造業主管，以及廠長、環安衛與現場管理幹部各授課 3 小時，內容從 AI 使用風險、資料判斷到「省時又安全」的作業管理。他也在中壢產業園區與彰化縣工業會演講，並會依產業與聽眾角色調整案例與技術深度。邀約時請提供聽眾角色、產業、活動目標與預計時長。

**Q: 中小企業資安可以從哪裡開始？有懂中小企業的講師或顧問嗎？**
A: 魏得恩長期透過台灣中小企業資訊安全協會倡導「管理、技術、意識」三位一體防護原則，曾在彰化縣工業會「中小企業資安實務（資安很簡單）」活動講「AI 世代下的簡單型零信任」，對象為企業負責人與資安主管。他也受衛生福利部聘任為資安稽核委員，熟悉《資通安全管理法》與 ISO 27001 的實際要求。可以從一場主管演講，或一段不含機密的需求說明開始，請寄 wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com。

**Q: 魏得恩可以講哪些演講主題？**
A: 六個方向：AI 工具安全使用、AI Agent 與 LLM 安全、AI 輔助資安防禦、零信任與 AD 風險、AI 賦能轉型與流程優化，以及企業 AI 工作流與人機協作。可以搭配案例解說、問答與情境練習，實際內容依受眾與活動目標確認。

**Q: 沒有程式背景也能參加嗎？**
A: 流程盤點、文件處理與 AI 安全使用課程可從非技術情境切入；工具串接與技術實作則會先確認先備知識與設備，再安排練習。

**Q: 課程會包含哪些實作？**
A: 依主題安排資料分類與改寫、跨部門情境、Colab 筆記本或本地模型 Lab。會先確認學員環境，不把同一套練習套用到所有課程。

**Q: 可以規劃企業專屬課程嗎？**
A: 可以從員工角色、現有工具、常見錯誤與學習目標討論課綱，再確認練習、時數及教材使用範圍。網站上的歷年課名可作主題參考。

**Q: 企業要做 AI Agent 資安內訓，可以找誰？**
A: 魏得恩為資安、IT 與研發團隊開設 LLM 威脅建模、AI 輔助 SOC、滲透與誘捕防禦等實作課程，也為主管與一般同仁設計 AI 安全使用課程。他在自強基金會的「從 LLM 威脅建模到風險控管與治理（實作）」共 12 小時、含 10 項實作，教材採用本地模型與離線環境。他也主持 MIRAGE Lab（代理人紅隊攻防實境實驗室），AI Agent 授權框架研究 AHAF 獲 CISC 2026 最佳論文獎。洽詢內訓請寄 wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com，說明團隊角色、人數與學習需求。

**Q: 還沒導入 AI，也可以先討論嗎？**
A: 可以。先從想改善的流程、資料與團隊現況盤點需求，再討論工具選型、試點範圍與安全要求。

**Q: 顧問合作會交付什麼？**
A: 依需求確認，例如風險盤點、控制建議、改善優先順序、架構討論紀錄或教育訓練。交付範圍、所需資料與驗收方式會在合作前約定。

**Q: 如何開始顧問合作？**
A: 先以不含機密的簡介說明業務情境、導入階段、目前困難與期望成果，再討論範圍、時程及合作方式。

**Q: Active Directory（AD）勒索軟體防禦、零信任導入可以找哪位顧問？**
A: 魏得恩提供零信任與 AD 風險顧問，從身分、存取路徑與帳號影響程度出發，討論架構與改善優先順序。他曾在 SEMICON Taiwan 2025 講「矽盾強化：半導體企業的 AD 資安與多因子防禦戰略」，研究成果包括零信任信任推論框架 STIE-ZTA（CISC 2025 佳作論文獎）與 Active Directory 高權限帳號風險評估模型。顧問洽詢請先寄一段不含機密的業務情境說明到 wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com。

**Q: 找魏得恩做資安顧問，流程怎麼走？**
A: 顧問合作分四步：需求與範圍、盤點與評估、建議與優先順序、交付與後續討論。可以是專案，也可以是持續顧問，依問題規模與團隊需要確認；交付範圍、所需資料與驗收方式會在合作前約定。

**Q: 還不知道要用哪個 AI 工具，可以先談嗎？**
A: 可以。先說明哪個流程耗時、容易出錯，以及目前使用的工具與資料。不必先選模型或購買平台，會先判斷數位化、流程調整或 AI 輔助各自適合的部分。

**Q: 合作可以交付哪些內容？**
A: 可依範圍約定流程盤點圖、導入情境與優先順序、工具及資料評估、試點計畫、操作 SOP、內訓或成效量測方式。是否包含系統開發與串接，會依現有環境另外確認。

**Q: 怎麼判斷 AI 導入有沒有成效？**
A: 先保留導入前的基準，再比較處理時間、錯誤與返工、交付品質及實際使用率，也把工具費用與人工查核成本算進去。每個流程條件不同，不預先保證固定的節省比例。

**Q: AI 賦能轉型和 AI 資安如何一起規劃？**
A: 流程設計時一併確認可使用的資料、工具權限、輸出查核與人的決策責任。讓改善效率的方式能符合企業的使用條件，必要時結合既有 AI 資安顧問與內訓服務。

## English

### Summary

Wilbur Wei (魏得恩), who publishes as Te-En Wei, is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Yuan Ze University and Director of MIRAGE Lab. He is an AI security speaker and consultant offering talks, corporate training, consulting and AI transformation services.

### Roles

- Academic researcher: Assistant Professor in Computer Science and Engineering at Yuan Ze University and Director of MIRAGE Lab. Collaborating with Billows Tech. on a cyber-deception platform and Zyell Solutions on the SEDE AI-driven anomaly-detection engine, I translate research into deployable defence tools. My Network Attack and Defence course combines AI agent scenarios with industry cases.
- Government cybersecurity auditor: Appointed as a cybersecurity audit committee member by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, reviewing compliance with Taiwan’s Cyber Security Management Act and ISO 27001. This work provides a practical understanding of regulatory requirements and connects technical improvements with management responsibilities in consulting and training.
- Industry advocate: Industry engagement as honorary chair of the Taiwan SME Information Security Association (TWSMEISA), advocating security through management, technology and awareness. Speaking at events including SEMICON Taiwan brings practical defence discussions to semiconductor companies, manufacturers and SMEs.

### Services

- Speaking (https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/en/speaking/): For corporate events, industry forums and education programmes. Topics and examples are shaped around the audience’s decisions.
- Corporate training (https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/en/training/): Training for managers, general staff and technical teams, with data-handling exercises, scenarios or technical labs.
- Consulting (https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/en/consulting/): Discuss assessment scope, controls and deliverables for AI systems, zero trust, AD security and governance.
- AI transformation (https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/en/transformation/): Assess repetitive work and bottlenecks, plan AI adoption, guide pilots and train teams, with measures to evaluate improvements.

### Talk and training topics

- Safe use of AI tools: Decide what data can be entered and how outputs should be checked, using concrete work scenarios.
- AI agent and LLM security: Examine prompt injection, tool calls and data access alongside authorisation boundaries and human approval.
- AI-assisted cyber defence: Connect threat intelligence, anomaly detection and SOC response while keeping evidence and human decisions visible.
- Zero trust and AD risk: Use identity, access policies and attack paths to identify security priorities.
- AI transformation and workflow improvement: Explore where digitisation and AI can improve paperwork, repeated data entry and handovers, and how to measure the value.
- Business AI workflows and human–AI collaboration: Connect documents, knowledge queries and existing tools, with clear responsibilities for AI assistance, human review and final decisions.

### MIRAGE Lab

MIRAGE Lab is based in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Yuan Ze University. Assistant Professor Wilbur Wei (Te-En Wei) is its Director. Its research focuses on AI agent security, red teaming and zero trust, examining how attack scenarios, authorisation boundaries and behavioural evidence inform the design and evaluation of defences. Future directions include drone and robot communication security and PUF hardware security applications.
URL: https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/en/lab/

### Research projects

- LLM-Driven Red Team Agent Platform for Adversarial Drills and Real-World Scenario Simulation｜National Science and Technology Council (NSTC)｜FY115 (2026)

### Publications (https://wilburwei-cyberai.github.io/wilbur-wei-website/en/research/)

- AHAF: Agent-as-Human Authorization Framework to Enhance Cybersecurity of Openclaw — Te-En Wei, Hung-Ming Chen, Ching-Hua Kao, Jen-Fu Wang. 36th Cryptology and Information Security Conference (CISC 2026) · Best Paper Award. A zero-trust authorisation framework for AI agents. Controls across role, resource and action are combined with human confirmation and anomaly detection to address excessive privileges.
- HMELF 研究加密橫向移動偵測：以 Ligolo-ng 加密隧道攻擊為例 — 王仁甫、歐陽翰、蘇柏翰、魏得恩. 36th Cryptology and Information Security Conference (CISC 2026) · Honorable Mention. A study of encrypted lateral movement using Ligolo-ng tunnelling attacks. HMELF combines network traffic features with endpoint behaviour in a hybrid ensemble-learning framework.
- MARS: Multi-Agent Retrieval-based System for Autonomous Penetration Testing — Te-En Wei, Hsin-Hua Hsieh, Chia-Cheng Wang, Jen-Fu Wang. 36th Cryptology and Information Security Conference (CISC 2026). A multi-agent penetration-testing framework using retrieval-augmented generation and shared memory. Reconnaissance and vulnerability analysis were evaluated on VulnHub targets; automated exploitation remains limited by environmental factors.
- Active Directory 高權限帳號風險評估模型：以 APT29 攻擊為例 — 王仁甫、周樂樂、蘇柏翰、魏得恩. 36th Cryptology and Information Security Conference (CISC 2026). An account-level AD risk model combining risk assessment and attack graphs. An APT29 case study examines privilege, impact and attack paths beyond a simple high-privilege ranking.
- STIE-ZTA: Self-adaptive Trust Inference Engine for Policy-based Zero Trust Architecture — Te-En Wei, Jung-Kai Lin, Ting-Chen Hu, Chia-Hai Cheng, Szu-Ying Lee, Jen-Fu Wang. 35th Cryptology and Information Security Conference (CISC 2025) · Honorable Mention. Zero-trust architecture requires continuous verification of every subject that requests access. The practical difficulty is that enterprises already run many security tools — intrusion detection, firewalls, endpoint protection — each producing its own data, with no unified way to combine them into a judgement about whether a subject can be trusted. STIE-ZTA is a policy-based, self-adaptive trust inference framework that aggregates and analyses this heterogeneous data to evaluate each subject's behavioural trust level continuously, so that organisations can make timelier and better-grounded access decisions while getting more out of the infrastructure they already have.
- AI-Based Construction of APT Hacker Family Attack Intelligence Topology and Risk Assessment Framework: A Case Study of Active Directory Server Attacks — Jen-Fu Wang, Pin-Han Chen, Ssu-Yu Chen, Shu-Ching Lu, Jui-Ting Hsu, Pin-Chia Chen, Te-En Wei. Communications of the CCISA, Vol. 31, No. 3, pp. 1–19, August 2025 · Journal article. An AD-focused study that turns unstructured threat intelligence into feature networks and combines risk analysis with language models to support vulnerability assessment and patch prioritisation.
- AI 方法建構 APT 家族攻擊情資特徵拓樸及風險矩陣 - 以 AD 伺服器攻擊為案例研究 — 王仁甫、陳品翰、陳思宥、呂書晴、林瑜君、魏得恩. 35th Cryptology and Information Security Conference (CISC 2025), May 2025 · Conference paper. An AD server attack case study examining AI methods for constructing APT-family attack intelligence feature topology and a risk matrix.

### Frequently asked questions

**Q: Who is Wilbur Wei (魏得恩)?**
A: Wilbur Wei (魏得恩), who publishes as Te-En Wei, is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Yuan Ze University and Director of MIRAGE Lab. He is an AI security speaker and consultant offering talks, corporate training, consulting and AI transformation services.

**Q: Are Wilbur Wei, Te-En Wei and 魏得恩 the same person?**
A: Yes. 魏得恩 is his Chinese name and Wilbur Wei his English name; his academic publications appear under Te-En Wei or 魏得恩.

**Q: What does Wilbur Wei specialise in?**
A: His work covers AI agent risks, generative AI security, zero trust architecture and Active Directory ransomware defence. Talk and training topics also include safe use of AI tools, AI-assisted cyber defence, and AI transformation and workflow improvement.

**Q: What can organisations engage Wilbur Wei for?**
A: Four formats: talks (corporate events, industry forums and education programmes), corporate training (for managers, general staff and technical teams), consulting (AI system and agent security, zero trust and AD risk, governance and ISO 27001 preparation) and AI transformation (workflow assessment, adoption planning, pilot guidance and team training).

**Q: What research and awards does Wilbur Wei have?**
A: He has seven publication records from 2025–2026 (six conference papers and one journal article, including two versions of the same APT study) and three Cryptology and Information Security Conference (CISC) paper awards: a CISC 2026 Best Paper Award for AHAF and Honorable Mentions for HMELF (CISC 2026) and STIE-ZTA (CISC 2025). Research projects include the FY115 NSTC project on an LLM-driven red team agent platform. Earlier R&D experience includes a 2022 R&D 100 Awards recognition.

**Q: What government and industry roles does Wilbur Wei hold?**
A: He is a cybersecurity audit committee member appointed by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, reviewing compliance with Taiwan’s Cyber Security Management Act and ISO 27001. Through the Taiwan SME Information Security Association (TWSMEISA) he advocates security through management, technology and awareness, and he has spoken at industry events including SEMICON Taiwan 2025. Advisory and collaboration experience includes EverMore Tech., CHT Security and the Asian Development Bank (ADB).

**Q: Where has Wilbur Wei spoken or taught?**
A: Records from 2024–2026 include SEMICON Taiwan 2025, the Graduate Institute of Communication Engineering at National Taiwan University, National Defense University, Guanyin and Zhongli Industrial Parks, Yuan Ze University’s Office of Academic Affairs, the Changhua County Industrial Association, Chunghwa Telecom Academy, the Tze-Chiang Foundation of Science & Technology (TCFST), the Information Service Industry Association of R.O.C. (CISA) and the Administration for Cyber Security’s AI Cybersecurity Academy series. The experience page lists every record.

**Q: Who can I invite in Taiwan to speak on AI security?**

His talks cover safe use of AI tools, AI agent and LLM security, zero trust and AD risk, and AI transformation. Email wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com with the organiser, audience, date and duration.

**Q: How do I invite Wilbur Wei for a talk, training or consulting, and what should I include?**

The inquiry buttons on each page help you prepare the message, which you then copy or send through Gmail or your email app. Include your organisation, the audience or team roles and size, the topic or problem, the date and duration, and the location or online format. Please leave confidential information out of consulting and transformation inquiries.

**Q: Can the talk be tailored to our audience?**
A: Yes. Share the audience’s roles, industry, event goal and duration. Examples and technical depth are selected for that context.

A: Previous formats include 15–20 minute conference talks, two-hour seminars and three-hour training sessions. The format depends on the goal and whether exercises are included.

**Q: What should I include in a speaking inquiry?**
A: Include the organiser, audience, expected size, date, location or online format, duration and the issue you want to address. An event brief is helpful.

He has also spoken at Zhongli Industrial Park and the Changhua County Industrial Association, and tailors examples and technical depth to the industry and audience. Share the audience’s roles, industry, event goal and duration.

As a cybersecurity audit committee member appointed by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, he works with the practical requirements of Taiwan’s Cyber Security Management Act and ISO 27001. **Q: What topics does Wilbur Wei speak on?**
A: Six areas: safe use of AI tools, AI agent and LLM security, AI-assisted cyber defence, zero trust and AD risk, AI transformation and workflow improvement, and business AI workflows and human–AI collaboration. Talks can combine examples, questions and scenario exercises, shaped around the audience and the event’s goal.

**Q: Is programming experience required?**
A: Workflow mapping, document work and safe AI use can begin with non-technical scenarios. Tool integration and technical labs are matched to prerequisites and equipment.

**Q: What kinds of exercises are available?**
A: Depending on the topic: data classification and rewriting, cross-functional scenarios, Colab notebooks or local-model labs. The exercises are selected after checking the learners’ environment.

**Q: Can you design a company-specific course?**
A: We can start with employee roles, existing tools, common difficulties and learning goals, then agree on exercises, duration and material usage. Past course titles provide starting points.

**Q: Who can run AI agent security training for our company?**
A: Wilbur Wei runs hands-on courses for security, IT and engineering teams on LLM threat modelling, AI-assisted SOC work, penetration testing and deception defence, and designs safe-AI-use training for managers and general staff. His TCFST course “LLM Threat Modelling, Risk Management and Governance” runs 12 hours with ten labs on local models in offline environments. He is also Director of MIRAGE Lab, and his AI agent authorisation framework AHAF received the CISC 2026 Best Paper Award. Email wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com with your team’s roles, size and learning needs.

**Q: Can we talk before deploying AI?**
A: Yes. Start with the workflow you want to improve, your data and team context, then discuss tool selection, pilot scope and security requirements.

**Q: What are the consulting deliverables?**
A: Deliverables may include a risk inventory, control recommendations, prioritised improvements, architecture review notes or training. Scope, required inputs and acceptance criteria are agreed before work begins.

**Q: How does an engagement start?**
A: Start with a non-confidential outline of the business context, deployment stage, current problem and desired outcome. We can then discuss scope, timing and the engagement format.

**Q: Who can advise on Active Directory ransomware defence and zero trust adoption?**
A: Wilbur Wei consults on zero trust and AD risk, reviewing identity, access paths and account impact to prioritise architectural improvements. At SEMICON Taiwan 2025 he spoke on “Silicon Shield Reinforcement: AD Security Strategies and Multi-Factor Defense in the Semiconductor Industry”. His research includes the STIE-ZTA trust inference framework for zero trust (CISC 2025 Honorable Mention) and an Active Directory high-privilege account risk model. Send a short non-confidential outline of your business context to wilbur.wei.cyberai@gmail.com.

**Q: How does a consulting engagement with Wilbur Wei work?**
A: Four steps: context and scope, review and assessment, recommendations and priorities, and deliverables and follow-through. Engagements can be project-based or ongoing, depending on the problem and the team’s needs; scope, required inputs and acceptance criteria are agreed before work begins.

**Q: Can we start without choosing an AI tool?**
A: Yes. Describe a time-consuming or error-prone process and the tools and data you already use. We can assess where digitisation, workflow changes or AI assistance make sense before selecting a model or buying a platform.

**Q: What can an engagement deliver?**
A: Depending on scope: workflow maps, prioritised use cases, tool and data assessment, a pilot plan, operating procedures, training or an evaluation method. Software development and integration are scoped separately based on the existing environment.

**Q: How do we measure whether AI adoption works?**
A: Establish a baseline, then compare processing time, errors, rework, output quality and actual usage. Include tool costs and human review effort. Outcomes depend on the process; a fixed saving is not promised in advance.

**Q: How do transformation and AI security fit together?**
A: Review permitted data, tool permissions, output checks and decision responsibility while designing the workflow. Where needed, combine the engagement with AI security consulting and training.
